items.title: Charlie Munger Said He’d ‘Never Sell a Share’ of Costco. $10,000 From 1997 Is Now Worth $833,000 and Gets a $22,535 Check on Dec. 4
items.summary: Costco's $30 special dividend goes to holders of record Nov. 24. For a couple who bought $10,000 of Costco the month Charlie Munger joined its board, that is a $22,535 check on top of shares worth $833,863, and selling would cost about $149,640 in federal tax.

items.title: Costco (COST) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher As AI Rollout Expands And Lawsuits Emerge
items.summary: The analyst fair value estimate for Costco Wholesale has shifted from US$1,057.94 to US$1,080.76, giving readers an updated anchor for thinking about the stock. That change sits against a backdrop of Costco Wholesale expanding its use of AI across pharmacy and fuel operations and facing proposed class action lawsuits over how tariff related refunds were handled for members. As you read on, you will see how these moving pieces feed into the evolving analyst narrative and what to watch...

items.title: Costco stock near 52-week high as panic buying looks priced in
items.summary: Investing.com -- Costco Wholesale Corp (COST) is trading at $1,112.41 (as of Nov 17, 2026, 3:25 PM EST). That is already $37.59 below Mizuho’s new $1,150 target, about 3.4% of upside.
